title: Short exactness of abelian sheaves is detected on stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and let $0\to F'\to F\to F''\to0$ be a sequence of abelian sheaves on $X$ [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Stalks $F_x$, germs and the induced stalk maps $\varphi_x$ of a morphism $\varphi$ are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], an abelian sheaf being a sheaf of modules over the constant presheaf of rings $\mathbb Z$. The sequence is short exact in $\operatorname{Ab}(X)$ if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the sequence of abelian groups $0\to F'_x\to F_x\to F''_x\to0$ is short exact.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AG (lemma-abelian), specialized to the constant sheaf of integers; Sheaves, Section 007S (section-exactness-points), for the stalk criterion

proof.text: For each point x the sheaf stalk functor preserves finite limits and finite colimits, by the instances in Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Abelian. Therefore ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact sends a short exact sheaf complex to a short exact stalk complex. Short exactness is the notion of [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

source.place: Sheaf stalk finite-limit instance and ShortExact.map_of_exact

proof.text: Conversely, suppose all stalk complexes are short exact. Their middle exactness implies S.Exact by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-exact-iff-stalk-exact]. To detect Mono S.f, form T=(0 -> S.X1 -> S.X2), with arrows 0 and S.f. By ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono, a clause of [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], T is exact iff S.f is mono. Every mapped T is exact by the same lemma, since its first arrow is zero (stalk functors preserve zero morphisms) and its second arrow is the mono first arrow of the mapped S. Apply [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-exact-iff-stalk-exact] to T to conclude Mono S.f. For Epi S.g, form T=(S.X2 -> S.X3 -> 0), with arrows S.g and 0; ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi and the same stalkwise exactness criterion imply Epi S.g from the epi second arrow of each mapped S. Recombine S.Exact, Mono S.f and Epi S.g using ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk', the definition in [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. The zero-composition condition already belongs to the given ShortComplex.

proof_origin.place: Stalk finite-limit/colimit instances; exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact applied at the middle and both zero-map endpoints; ShortExact.map_of_exact and ShortExact.mk'. Implements the stalk criterion of Modules 01AG / Sheaves 007S.
